inAlbania - PM Rama: 2027 budget exceeds 10 billion euros

en.summary: The Rama government's 2027 budget spends over €10bn, with welfare, fiscal stability and investment plus EU accession as its three priorities. It targets public investment of ALL 201.5bn (6.9% of GDP), a 2.3% deficit and 52.4% public debt, and aims to finish technical EU talks by December 2027.
en.leader: Prime Minister Edi Rama (head of government) / Finance Minister Petrit Malaj
agenda: Speed up EU accession (technical talks done by Dec 2027)
Public investment ALL 201.5bn (6.9% of GDP)
Infrastructure and energy ALL 75.4bn
More welfare, including a doubled pensioner bonus
Fiscal stability: 2.3% deficit, 52.4% debt
Farm support ALL 5.3bn
